visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Best Value Starts at Zero
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The amount 6 can be made from two coins (3 + 3), but the program prints 0.

solution.explanation: Each dp[a] must start as a number bigger than any real answer, so that the first valid coin count replaces it. Starting at 0 makes every candidate look worse, and the minimum is never updated.
